notes.title: Last minute changes (Early Access 57.4)
notes.notes:
[h2]Rootin' Tootin' Lootin' & Shootin' will release tomorrow![/h2]

[list]
[*] Reduced chance for duplicate items and upgrades to appear in the shop
[*] Secret rooms now contain a present instead of a weapon
[*] Certain levels can no longer be seen or edited in the custom levels list
[*] Shopkeeper now ignores bullets that deal no damage
[*] The probability of each upgrade appearing is now based on its rarity
[*] Improved Risky's behaviour in City of Gold 1
[*] Adjusted buttons in the pause menu
[/list]

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
I'm excited to announce the 1.0 release date for Rootin' Tootin' Lootin' & Shootin'!
Please watch the trailer below.

[previewyoutube=qvOPAHHR57c;full][/previewyoutube]

That's right - the game will be launching on the [b]28th of August 2025[/b] - that's less than 6 weeks away!
Please Wishlist the game if you haven't already, or continue playing in Early Access, which will receive weekly updates all the way up to the full release!

notes.title: Major Demo Update!
notes.notes:
I have been hard at work on Rootin' Tootin' Lootin' & Shootin' over the past couple of months, and finally have a new demo ready!​

There are a few big changes, but also lots of quality of life features to make the game easier to learn for new players.
If you are enjoying the demo, please, don't forget to Wishlist the game!


[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[h2]Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] 5 new enemies
[*] You can choose from 6 starting items
[*] You can fall into pits
[*] You can click the inventory to select items
[*] You now have 4 hearts of health and cannot store bandages
[*] Onboarding button prompts
[*] Settings with arrow buttons have been replaced with sliders
[*] Food items tell you what they do
[/list]
[h2]Removals[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed grab/throw button
[/list]
[h2]Major Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Enemies are now randomly chosen based on a difficulty scoring system
[*] Bandages restock
[*] Items in the shop can no longer be damaged
[*] Items can be picked up by walking over them
[*] Settings save automatically
[/list]
[h2]Minor Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved enemy pathfinding
[*] Reduced record file sizes
[*] Adjusted item prices
[*] Improved button prompts
[*] Settings can be reset without restarting the game
[/list]
